verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own US cards page advertises "2% Cashback" on its corporate cards, so a first-party cashback capability on card spend exists. The evidence is only a marketing page title, though, and says nothing about how cashback is credited or whether it is automatic without redemption steps. Missing for 10: documentation that cashback is credited automatically with no manual redemption, eligibility and terms detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
